title: Five more operator-facing strings still point operators at 'tk cloud/factory' commands ticfac does not serve
body: Same defect shape as the gwi line, same cause (the factory move ported text verbatim and never repointed the pointer): internal/cli/cloud.go:117 and :121 say "run 'tk factory setup'" where this binary serves `ticfac factory setup`; cloud.go:875 and :882 say "then run 'tk cloud run %s' again"; cloud_logs.go:374 says "see 'tk cloud supervisor %s'"; cloud_logs.go:444 says "read one with: tk cloud logs %s --tick <id>"; cloud_runid.go:101 says "or list the runs with 'tk cloud status'". An operator or agent following any of them runs a binary this repository does not ship and clears nothing. A repair should fix every site in one change and add a guard test; note cloud_logs_test.go:438 currently ASSERTS the misdirected 'tk cloud supervisor run_2xm' string, so that assertion must be repointed with the source or the suite will refuse the fix.
